goal.en: Repair one challenged canonical instruction/rule and affected references from concrete applicability evidence.

graphPolicy.location: .starciwork node dependsOn/refs with direct sourceRefs and collocated assets

purpose.en: Read the existing selected N/index.yaml, ancestor scope, declared refs/dependencies/assertions and validator freshness. This consumer op requires its target node to exist. An absent target is a scope/graph gap: report it and propose a separately selected scope op; do not create a target or invent its acceptance/graph here.

When source exists/is selected, resolve repository resource, actual checkout/root/HEAD and dirty state; read applicable instructions, manifests, owning code, callers and relevant tests. Greenfield/spec-only work records source not-yet-created and grounds intent in the user request; no invented repository or fact citation. Source implementation still needs an actual selected writable repository.

reads.path: selected canonical knowledge file + affected references + applicable owner maintenance policy + original challenge evidence

purpose.en: Read the actual rule identifier/case and its owner/callers, observed counterexamples and existing enforcement. Read relevant skill instructions fully if editing a skill.

Only when explicitly selected in a job matrix, read the exact cell ID, operation, immutable input bindings, requested output JSON shapes and required criteria. Standalone execution needs no fabricated matrix request. A template is not authority for extra effects.

reads.path: profiles/registry.json + selected runtime execution profile + actual host tools/model

purpose.en: Select the actual host runtime codex or claude and this operator role from the V2-derived active profiles. Use current host model configuration; historical model names are not availability proof. Capabilities are the intersection of actual tools, selected profile policy, op permissions and existing task authority. Do not revive V2 dispatch chains, retired profiles or extra-agent permissions.

content.en: Read the existing selected scope, expected assertions and .starciwork graph unchanged. Write only state/blocker/completion here; actual observations, findings, commit mappings and remaining cleanup belong to the evidence result, not semantic node prose. Missing refs/dependencies/acceptance require a reported gap or separately selected scope update; never add/remove them to obtain pass.
Only exact owned paths in the approved code-scope, with smallest required caller/integration changes; record actual diff and commit mapping, not proposed changes as delivered.

Keep applicability findings, exact before/after authority paths, actual validator/citation/reference checks and origin-context retest when included. Operator-specific observed result in E/result.md: Record evidence-backed reason and canonical owner, preserving stable rule IDs and existing valid scope. A one-off preference is not universal law.

Only for a selected job matrix, return the exact request-bound result. Populate every declared cell output with actual canonical Work/source/runtime references or produced JSON artifacts from this job; retain real artifact bytes and hashes. Do not rename/regenerate upstream expectations. Missing required output/evidence remains blocked or failed and cannot advance. The selected request freezes output field schemas before execution.

action.en: Check whether the issue is existing enforcement failure, missing concept, wrong existing rule or duplicate concept using the actual maintenance policy of the selected owner. Choose one canonical owner before edits. Resolve the execution profile and actual tool availability before selecting instruments; this does not switch the model/runtime or spawn workers.

Make smallest scoped rule/gate/step repair with stable IDs, same-commit affected reference updates and no product-specific law. Update genuine callers/contracts together; do not patch consumers as hidden workaround.

Run actual relevant validation/citation/parity and behavioral regression checks. Generated documents use their owned generators; inspect changes rather than claiming textual shape proves sound guidance.

Commit owned change when authorized and report exact originating context needing re-evaluation. Do not automatically rerun its operation or claim visual correctness. When selected in a job matrix, produce E/job-result.json bound to the exact request, its output schema and every required criterion. This handoff is conditional and does not change standalone or named frontend response contracts.

requirement.en: Run workspace validation; every cited ID/path exists or is explicitly proposed, required assertions are covered, input bindings are current, and an honest not-run/fail cannot earn done.
Inspect exact staged diff and actual tests; bind full real source commit(s), per repository, and separately retain integration/tested mappings. Report uncommitted or no-change honestly.
Repair follows canonical ownership and actual rule-applicability evidence; affected references and applicable regressions validate.

condition.en: Challenge cannot be grounded in a canonical owner/applicable case or needs wider authority.

A declared prerequisite is not effectively done, or a required declared input/scope is missing. Report node/resource IDs and propose a separately selected graph update when needed; never run predecessors or weaken dependsOn/refs/required to proceed.

placeholders.repo-id: Resolved direct repository name or path
